cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Welcome to the swimming club! You're very welcome to watch until your induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Absolutely, once you've observed one. Today you can watch from the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you there. Poolside access requires induction, though. Let's find you a brochure with a lovely view.
